The Slack ✉ chip now opens the Slack pane at once, even while Claude is working, and the `/desk-activity` legend explains the gray `▪` bars.

- Pressing the ✉ chip under the prompt during a turn did nothing until the turn ended, because the chip ran `/desk-slack` the way a plugin runs a command, which waits for the session to be idle. desk-look now tells desk-slack directly, so the pane opens and refreshes right away
- The `/desk-activity` timeline drew calls to other tools (MCP tools, skills, questions and the like) as gray `▪` bars without saying what they were. The legend now adds `▪ other` when the turn has such calls

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
